Module that integrates three into Cesium.
[Note] Cesium's own render loop must be disabled (`useDefaultRenderLoop: false`).
结构发生**不兼容**变更时才递增；载入时版本对不上会直接报错，\n而不是按新结:
Incremented only on **incompatible** structural changes; loading a mismatched version fails immediately
instead of reading old data with the new structure (height field misalignment is the hardest class of bug to diagnose).
开启后会接管左键拖动（Cesium 的旋转相机被临时关闭，滚轮缩放仍可用），\n:
When enabled it takes over left-button dragging (Cesium's camera rotation is temporarily disabled; wheel zoom still works),
and shows a circular brush cursor hugging the terrain; disabling it restores camera interaction.
第二个第三个分别表示底座圆心的坐标,第四个表示切割成多少个点。\n组成多少个面。:
The second and third values are the coordinates of the base centre, the fourth is how many points it is cut into —
and therefore how many faces it has. More faces make it slower; keep the number as low as the project can tolerate.
用局部三维坐标算噪声（不做投影），所以密度处处一致、不会被拉伸；\n再叠一层沿高:
Noise is computed in local 3D coordinates (no projection), so the density is uniform everywhere and never stretched;
a second layer of strata along the height direction makes it look like a mechanically excavated rock cross-section.
效果是：块面边缘和真实地形**逐点重合**，没有裙边、没有台阶；\n块面内部仍是:
The effect: the patch edge **coincides point by point** with the real terrain — no skirt, no step;
inside the patch the height is the real post-edit height and is not dragged along by the LOD.
生成过程会按格网采样真实地形高度，因此返回 Promise；\n采样失败（例如没:
Creation samples the real terrain height over the grid, hence the Promise;
when sampling fails (e.g. no terrain configured) it degrades to a flat plane at elevation 0.
只对矩形「区域」模式生效：手绘多边形模式下块面被 `inside` 掩膜裁过，\:
Only effective in the rectangular "area" mode: in hand-drawn polygon mode the patch is clipped by the `inside` mask,
and carving with the rectangle would remove an extra ring of terrain outside the polygon.
默认开启：近垂直立面用 3D 噪声岩土替代影像，避免影像被拉成竖条 / 折叠；\:
Enabled by default: near-vertical faces use 3D noise rock and soil instead of imagery, so the imagery is not stretched into stripes or folded;
gentle slopes still rely on imagery. Turning it off keeps the imagery untouched.
地形笔刷的手感是「按住不放就一直挖」，而不是「移动一次算一次」：\n指针停在原地:
A terrain brush should feel like "hold and keep digging" rather than "one move, one step":
while the pointer stays put it keeps lowering / raising, and releasing the left button stops it.
是 `apply()` 的语义化封装：基坑≈下沉、土堆≈抬升、平台≈整平，坡道按:
A semantic wrapper around `apply()`: pit ≈ lower, mound ≈ raise, platform ≈ flatten, and ramp slopes up linearly along a direction.
Changes are recorded in the undo history automatically.
正常情况下块面和当前渲染地形只差一两米；上限只用来兜「瓦片还没加载完」的\n极端:
Normally the patch and the currently rendered terrain differ by only a metre or two; the cap only covers the extreme case
"tiles are still loading", so the patch is never pulled down into a gully tens of metres deep.
只在相机停稳、地形瓦片加载完成后才重算，移动过程中沿用上一次的对齐量，\n避免旋:
Recomputed only once the camera settles and terrain tiles have finished loading; during movement the previous alignment is reused
to avoid scanning the whole boundary every frame and blocking the main thread while rotating.
与「把格网边画成线框」不同，这里按固定等高距求等值线，\n所以缓坡上线稀疏、陡坡:
Unlike "drawing the grid edges as wireframe", this derives isolines at a fixed contour interval,
so lines are sparse on gentle slopes and dense on steep ones — the same look as terrain software.
开启后会向当前影像图层要瓦片，把地表纹理贴到编辑区，\n挖开的地表仍是它本来的颜:
When enabled it requests tiles from the current imagery layer and drapes the ground texture over the edit area,
so excavated ground keeps its natural colour instead of being a solid-colour mesh.
水面按格网裁剪：只保留「四角都低于水位」的格子，因此水只出现在坑底，\n不会顺着:
Water is clipped to the grid: only cells whose four corners are all below the water level are kept, so water appears only at the pit floor
and never floods the side slopes along the polygon.
模型，3ditiles等实体位置调整面板，\n获取调整后的模型矩阵与平移矩阵:
Panel for adjusting the position of models, 3D Tiles and other entities;
returns the adjusted model matrix and translation matrix.
